items.context: @Cointelegraph (2.925.529 seguidores), en inglés: "JUST IN: Chainlink launches CustodySync with Anchorage Digital, enabling institutions to borrow from DeFi lending markets without moving their assets out of qualified custody." Publicado hace ~10 min: 14.923 vistas, 22 likes y solo 9 respuestas. Ángulo: custodia (custodia institucional vs autocustodia).
items.suggested_text:
Worth noticing what problem this actually solves. Institutions want DeFi yield, but their mandate says the assets can't leave a qualified custodian, so the product's real job is keeping keys exactly where they are while the exposure moves. Custody stays the anchor; the yield becomes a layer of permissions on top.

For a fund that's a feature. For an individual it's the reverse trade-off: every layer added between you and your keys is one more party whose solvency, security and rules you're trusting. "Not your keys, not your coins" was never about distrusting one specific company; it's about how many failure points sit in the chain.

The more convenient custody becomes for institutions, the more it's worth asking what holding your own actually requires.

I wrote a step-by-step guide to building an air-gapped setup yourself: https://x.com/ForecastQuant/status/2123585216740528526
